title: CVSLab
description: CVS Lab canonical schemas, schema_version 1. Generated by `python -m cvslab schema export`; do not edit.

Ablation.description: A#### — a scientific intervention relative to a frozen baseline (or the baseline itself).
Ablation.title: Ablation

CatalogRecord.description: One canonical record rendered in the corpus catalog, labels joined and memberships resolved.
CatalogRecord.title: CatalogRecord

Compute.description: Executed compute, recorded as a research variable. All values are measured.
Compute.title: Compute

Dataset.description: D#### — frozen dataset manifest: a reproducible selection over canonical records.
Dataset.title: Dataset

EvaluationProtocol.description: E#### — frozen evaluation instrument pinned to one dataset manifest.
EvaluationProtocol.title: EvaluationProtocol

Finding.description: F#### — the standard finding card. Immutable; a revision supersedes, never edits.
Finding.title: Finding

FunnelRun.description: R#### imported information-gain labeling funnel run (engine `training/funnel`).
FunnelRun.title: FunnelRun

IntakeRecord.description: I#### — one import of the legacy catalog: what was verified, assigned and reused.
IntakeRecord.title: IntakeRecord

LabelSetRef.description: One append-only L2 label file pinned into a dataset manifest.
LabelSetRef.title: LabelSetRef

LabelsAppendRequest.description: Append a new label set to a canonical corpus; existing records and labels are never modified.
LabelsAppendRequest.title: LabelsAppendRequest

LegacyEvidence.description: R#### imported gate or measurement record from the legacy engine.
LegacyEvidence.title: LegacyEvidence

LegacyModel.description: M#### imported from the legacy catalog: inspectable, never promotable, never a warm start by default.
LegacyModel.title: LegacyModel

MapNode.description: One spatial object on the Lab Map; `detail` is display evidence, `link` the 2D page.
MapNode.title: MapNode

ModelArtifact.description: M#### — a serialized model produced by exactly one lab run.
ModelArtifact.title: ModelArtifact

Normalization.description: N#### — versioned standardization of sources into canonical records.
Normalization.title: Normalization

Run.description: R#### — one execution of an ablation. Immutable once COMPLETED or INVALID.
Run.title: Run

SearchSwitch.description: An engine search switch as a clean-lineage backlog item: legacy evidence sets priority, not truth.
SearchSwitch.title: SearchSwitch

StackArm.description: One component of a dataset stack: a filtered subpopulation plus an explicit sampling policy.
StackArm.title: StackArm

Switch.description: A registered experimental variable. Only registered switches may appear in a configuration.
Switch.title: Switch

TrainingRecipe.description: T#### — frozen trainer identity and training/signal/compute settings.
TrainingRecipe.title: TrainingRecipe
